gloss: to mention; to go so far as to refer to

definitions.gloss: to mention; to go so far as to refer to
definitions.explanation: For one's remarks to extend to a particular topic in the course of speaking, especially to bring up something beyond the original subject.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{及|およ}んだ。
examples.english: The conversation came to touch on the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{私生活|しせいかつ}→私生活：15112_shiseikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{言|い}い{及|およ}んだ。
examples.english: He went so far as to comment on others' private lives.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{言|い}い{及|およ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The report refers not only to the cause but also to future countermeasures.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive godan verb. X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ. Compound of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{及|およ}ぶ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧ (to reach, to extend). Describes a discussion reaching or extending to a topic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧が〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ: for the talk to come around to ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ: to go so far as to mention ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: to touch on — a lighter, brief mention; {言|い}い{及|およ}ぶ implies the talk extends there
- ⟦{言及|げんきゅう}→言及：10894_genkyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refer to — a more formal ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb with the same kanji
